nodes.body: 'vehicle1_c1' is a specialization of 'vehicle1' (technically a subset). It inherits all the parts of 'vehicle1' and only needs to specify additional or redefined parts.
The mass is further redefined to override the default value with a bound value for 'vehicle_c1'.
'frontWheel' is inherited from 'vehicle1'::'frontAxleAssembly', allowing it to be used in the following part declarations.
'frontAxle_c1' redefines 'frontAxleAssembly'::'frontAxle' to give it a new name and the specialized type 'FrontAxle'.
'rearAxle_c1' redefines 'rearAxleAssembly'::'rearAxle' to give it a new name. It inherits the type 'Axle' from the redefined part.

entries.text: The mass attribute is redefined to give it a default value.
